chime.description: Warm rolled chord of soft marimba notes, a task finished.

click-soft.description: Muted wooden knock for a button press.

error.description: Low error buzz: two notes falling.

impact-bass-1.description: Heavy cinematic hit with a long tail.

notification.description: Two-tone notification chime, like a small doorbell.

ping.description: Small glass ting for a selected item.

riser.description: Rising noise riser building to a cut.

sparkle.description: Three glass tings climbing with a sparkle of air, a success chime.

typing.description: Light dull plastic key tap (six repeated taps).

whoosh-cinematic.description: Air rushing past, left to right.

whoosh-short.description: Fast thin slice of air for cuts.

whoosh.description: Bright airy swish passing from left to right.
